name: NEUROSTRIKE LEAGUE: Season 12
subcategory: competitive esports / neural reflex combat sim
description: NeuroStrike is M88's premier corporate-sponsored esport: five-player teams compete in a BCI-integrated tactical combat simulation where neural reaction speed, not physical reflexes, determines performance — the fastest synaptic responders in the world operate at 0.003-second decision windows, and the gap between amateur and professional is measured in milliseconds of pure thought. Season 12 introduced the controversial Augmentation Draft, allowing teams to temporarily license neural enhancement packages to players for tournament play, sparking fierce debate about the line between skill and purchased biology.
story_hooks: A Tier 1 prodigy with unaugmented reaction times that surpass enhanced professionals is being courted by three different corporate teams — all of whom have reasons to want her under exclusive contract.
Someone is neural-casting matches with a hidden secondary feed that captures full unencrypted player cognition — intimate thoughts, fears, and memories broadcast to a subscriber list of unknown size.
A beloved veteran player announces retirement, then is seen practicing in an underground facility with a team that doesn't officially exist.
